commit_message: Add ADR 0122 managed audio voice backend
pr_title: Implement ADR 0122 spatial audio mixer and authoring UX
pr_body: Continues ADR 0122 on the existing Draft PR. This slice adds platform-owned managed sound-effect voices with runtime-only identity, start/stop/completion lifecycle, looping playback, dynamic stereo-gain updates without decode or restart, active-voice bounds, and existing master/SE bus integration.
